provenance.run: the 2026-10-22 Target Tap paid run (run 1), code_review's reviewed and delivered commit
provenance.method: git ls-tree -r -l and git cat-file blob at the commit; each file's bytes rehashed to its git blob ID before writing
provenance.manifest: every path in the commit's tree, with mode, blob ID and size; `files` holds the bytes of each captured path as UTF-8 text, LF line endings as committed
provenance.dropped: the bytes of every path outside index.html, package.json and src/: the tests, docs, lockfile, governed.yaml, .gitignore, README.md and tool configs. They remain named, with their blob IDs, in `manifest`
